suite.description: Identity Resource profile vectors (IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §12.2 ID-05): the initial change, admission AI0 to AI4, per-entry state validation, pairing links, device fingerprints, the approval digest, rootOf tables and assignee display.

conventions.changes: Every change is made with time 0 and no message by the SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §8 actor of its writer in the Identity Resource I; the change.* cases give their exact bytes and framing; validation cases reference their causal history by case.
conventions.writer_class: inputs.writer_class is the class of §2.3 at inputs.control_ref, from the Control state of I in LFCP-IDENTITY-TEST-VECTORS-01.
conventions.diagnostics: A refused change or an invalid entry is PROFILE_INVALID with the profile diagnostic; a conflicted entry (§4 rule 2) has no diagnostic of its own.
conventions.links: Pairing-link rejections are client-local (W §62): error.code PAIRING_LINK_REJECTED is a test convention, not a wire code.

suite.warning: All private keys in this suite are public test fixtures. They MUST NOT be used in production.

snapshot.loaded_after: the root's unit 1 is fetched and verified

assertions: The unit-1 change is the initial change in every order; the unit-2 change is INVALID_ROOT at once (AI0 runs before the sequence hold of SOP §14.1) and is never held; the fill depends on it and waits forever.
A KEY_BLOCKED unit 1 holds the whole document until it opens; nothing else becomes the initial change meanwhile.
The same choice is made from a Snapshot once the root's unit 1 is fetched and its change is found in the Snapshot.

cases.description: A Snapshot whose change without dependencies is not the change of the root's Data Unit with actor sequence 1 (C0_initial)

rule.text: A replica that loads the document from a Snapshot takes the Snapshot's change without dependencies as the initial change only after it holds and has verified the root's Data Unit with actor sequence 1 and found that change in it.

assertions: The Snapshot's state is not used; the replica replays the units instead.

cases.description: The pairing link of PAIR_J for I

rule.text: lfcp://pair/<identity-resource-b64url>?endpoint=<escaped-wss-url>&device=<pairing-device-id-b64url>#secret=<secret-b64url>; the secret is the W §18.2 invite-secret structure.

cases.description: An invitation parser receives the pairing link

rule.text: A receiver of invitation URIs that does not implement pairing rejects the link as not starting with lfcp://join/.

cases.description: A pairing link whose device parameter is DEV_B while the secret is PAIR_J's

rule.text: The receiving client recomputes J's descriptor from the secret and verifies that its ID equals device before using the secret.

error.detail: the secret's Principal is not device

cases.description: The device fingerprint of DEV_B

rule.text: fp = base32-lower-nopad(SHA-256(ASCII('LFCP-DEVICE-FP-v1') || principal_id)[0..10]) in four groups of four characters.

cases.description: The certificate payload digest of CERT_B, equal to P3's field 4

rule.text: The certificate payload digest is SHA-256 of the exact COSE payload; it is what a pairing approval commits to.

cases.description: rootOf, actsFor, bound and active of every fixture Principal in X at I2, I9, I11 and I13

rule.text: rootOf(P) is the root of a bound Principal, revoked or intermediate included, else P; actsFor(P) is the root of an active device, else P.

assertions: The tables equal the queries of the corresponding cases of LFCP-IDENTITY-TEST-VECTORS-01.

cases.description: A task in X with assignees p:<DEV_B>, p:<OWNER> and p:<BOB>, displayed at I13

rule.text: A reader treats p:<D> and p:<R> with rootOf(D) = R as the same human for display and filtering; the CRDT set is unchanged.

assertions: Two keys for one human are two members of the set and are merged in display only.
